meta.name: triage-suspicious-login
meta.description: Triage suspicious login alerts like impossible travel, untrusted location, or multiple failures. Use when investigating authentication anomalies. Analyzes user history, source IP reputation, login patterns, and determines if escalation is needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析可疑登录告警并判断是否需要升级处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理异常登录告警并快速决策
copy.tagline_en: Analyze suspicious login alerts and decide if escalation is needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently handle suspicious login alerts and need quick triage

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会主动调查可疑登录告警：提取用户、源IP等信息，分析登录模式，判断是合法、可疑还是恶意，给出风险分数和升级建议。
howto.when: 当你提供可疑登录案件的 ID 或相关标识（如用户ID、源IP）时触发。

say.text: 调查这个可疑登录案件，案件ID是12345。
分析用户 alice 从 IP 1.2.3.4 登录是否可疑。
say.note: 跳过案件查找，直接分析。

say.text: 检查最近96小时内 bob 的登录模式。
say.note: 聚焦近期登录活动分析。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude will automatically triage suspicious login alerts: extract user and source IP, analyze login patterns, determine if legitimate/suspicious/malicious, and output risk score and escalation recommendation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a suspicious login case ID or related identifiers (e.g., user ID, source IP).

say_en.text: Investigate this suspicious login case with ID 12345.
say_en.note: Claude will start the triage workflow.

say_en.text: Analyze if user alice logging from IP 1.2.3.4 is suspicious.
say_en.note: Skip case lookup, go straight to analysis.

say_en.text: Check login patterns for bob in the last 96 hours.
